title.quote: PREDICTIVE INFERENCE FOR TRAVEL TIME ON TRANSPORTATION NETWORKS
title.justification: This is the paper title shown on the first page.
title.value: Predictive Inference for Travel Time on Transportation Networks

extractions.description: Develops and evaluates fitted population and trip-specific travel-time predictive distributions and prediction intervals using Quebec City mobile-GPS trips, with comparisons against HMM, independence, and linear-regression alternatives.

type.quote: We develop efficient inference methods for such parameters and propose asymptotically tight population prediction intervals for travel time... Our methods... are illustrated in a real-world case study using mobile GPS data
type.justification: The paper contains theory but also fits and quantitatively evaluates the methods on a real-world train/test split, so it is catalogued as empirical.

name.quote: Keywords and phrases: Central limit theorem, Mixing sequence, Dynamical systems, Prediction intervals, Travel time estimation.
name.justification: The paper explicitly identifies travel-time estimation as a subject and contributes predictive methods for it.

name.quote: We consider a transportation network G to be a graph with stochastic edge-weights (speeds) governing the travel time of the edge.
name.justification: Transportation networks are the application domain directly advanced by the proposed inference methods.

name.quote: We develop efficient inference methods for such parameters and propose asymptotically tight population prediction intervals for travel time.
name.justification: The work directly contributes methods for predictive inference and prediction intervals.

name.quote: our second contribution is to build trip-specific mean and covariance sequences... that... can centre and normalize travel time to an asymptotic Gaussian-based predictive distribution
name.justification: The paper develops statistical methodology for stochastic processes with dependence.

name.quote: our work falls into this category, by providing a limit theorem for a type of mixing process on ergodic dynamical networks
name.justification: Dynamical systems and mixing processes are advanced through the paper's limit theorem.
